title: FX canvas layout file, <workflow id>.layout.json (fx-layout-v1)
description: Ratified design, not implemented (layout.md §6): where the viewer places a workflow's declared steps. It lives in the folder of the workflow's takes file and is read as UTF-8 I-JSON of at most 1 MiB (identity.md §1). An invalid file is not applied at all. Planning, expansion, runs, resume and the store never read it; it is not part of the plan digest (identity.md §10).

steps.description: Declaration path to entry. One key covers every instance of its step, in plan and run views, at any count. An empty object draws exactly what no file draws.

propertyNames.description: A declaration path (layout.md §6.2): step names joined by `.`, with no repeat key and no take: `sheet`, `badge.draw`.

column.description: The slot's column in its container's coordinates, given with `row` (layout.md §4, rule 9). Empty tracks collapse, so only the order of values matters (rule 10).

row.description: The slot's row in its container's coordinates, given with `column`.

repeats.description: How the step's members draw: `deck`, the engine default, stacks them; `grid` spreads the slot's outer level (items, matrix combinations or group iterations, else takes), and an inner take level stays a deck (layout.md §6.3).
